canon_notes.dorowani_eyes: DOROWANI EYE CANON (owner ruling, 2026-10-27; attribution corrected by the owner 2026-10-28): the Dorowani SPECIES' eyes are red + black with NO sclera whites. The one specific made/generated Dorowani individual from the owner's original ruling - the only Dorowani canonically with white around his eyes, and the Dorowani of EP01 - HAS eye-whites - a kept special-case individual deviation (owner: do not scrap; keep consistent for this individual in every future generation; the whites are fixed and steady for him, never growing, shrinking or flickering, and never extended to any other Dorowani). canon_notes.kittember_stance: KITTEMBER STANCE DOCTRINE (owner ruling, 2026-10-27, as corrected same day): the Kittember SPECIES default going forward is QUADRUPEDAL. The BIPEDAL Kittember - the grey canon-pass bundles of PR #399 (orb tail) - is a special-case WILD individual: Mochiko's first wild Kittember encounter - stare-down in the woods, vanishes, reappears, battle + capture, joins the team. The #389 black quadruped was held as a special-case DRAFT under the 2026-10-27 ruling (PR #401's original label; an intermediate same-day amendment that swapped the two individuals was itself corrected and reverted) - SUPERSEDED 2026-10-28: the owner ruled the #389 form CANON as the Region 4 regional Kittember variant, its seven deviations from the base form being that regional form's locked traits. It is still NOT the wild individual. The species default and the wild individual in this note are unchanged.

framing_verification.detail: Same measure as the failed attempts (content = any channel < 235), run on the finished normalised 720x720 clip. Seam close-ups at both old edge lines (frames 184, 160) show no guillotine line or pattern break; recorded caveat in the bundle manifest: the continuation is a radial dissolve, not recovered arc curvature.
